messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering anomaly detected in prod — token-count delta > 20% for EU/hosted for the last 15m. Auto-escalating to on-call.
jordan: saw this in dashboard a few mins ago, metrics show token emit spikes from proxy pool P-7.
maya: is this real or an ingest lag? delayed windows could show weird deltas. any evidence of replays?
eng-billing: digging — initial look: token aggregator batches are emitting duplicates for sequences with empty epk. stacktrace from emitter attached to the alert: `NullPointer at TokenEmitter.emitIfNeeded`
ops-lead: ok set incident channel, tagging finance and support. jordan, can you confirm customer-facing overage flags?
jordan: yes — two customers triggered auto-overage email around 09:12 UTC. support-ops is pinged.
support-ops: confirmed, ticket created PROD-2345, customers A and B. they reported unexpected usage spike and invoice alert.
oncall-bot: @eng-billing you are on-call. Handoff: priority P1, assign to eng-billing and maya.
eng-billing: temporary mitigation plan: pause emitter retries for P-7, enable dedupe window for 30m, and kick an ingest backfill to reconcile counts. rolling a small config change now.
maya: will monitor ledger discrepancies. setting up a quick query: `SELECT count FROM tokens WHERE emit_ts BETWEEN now()-1h AND now()` for shadow ledger.
ops-lead: do not run backfill until we have safe dedupe in place — otherwise we risk double-correcting.
jordan: I see queued backfill job flagged but not started. will hold.
eng-billing: rolled config: `EMITTER_RETRIES=0` on P-7 (deploy id: deploy-8921). patch applied to 3 nodes, health OK.
sara: spotted latency on metering pipeline while change rolled, but no new overage flags since deploy.
maya: shadow ledger shows ~18% higher counts on ingest vs api-reads during spike window (09:00-09:15). suggests duplicate emits, not delayed ingestion.
eng-billing: confirming duplicate key pattern: multiple records with same req_id and different emit_ts. dedupe window should collapse these. enabling `dedupe_ms=60000`.
support-ops: drafting customer note: short explanation + apology + promise of adjustment. want a quick approval before send?
ops-lead: approve the draft, delay visible billing corrections until after reconciliation. notify customers that adjustments will appear within 48h.
jordan: running reconciliation job in dry-run against shadow ledger now. output sample: `customer=A old=12k new=9.4k delta=-2.6k`
eng-billing: dry-run shows expected negative adjustments for impacted customers. starting safe reconciliation after 15m monitoring window. will create a final audit log.
oncall-bot: escalation to billing-sre if counts don't stabilize in 30m.
maya: counts trending down to normal after dedupe window — current delta now at 3.5% (was 22%).
support-ops: sending customer note now (internal copy): "We're investigating an internal billing calculation issue that may have temporarily inflated usage. We're pausing retries and reconciling counts; you'll see any billing corrections within 48 hours. Sorry for the noise."
sara: support ticket updated, customers acknowledged and appreciated proactive outreach.
eng-billing: reconciliation started (job id recon-778). logging everything to kinesis and archive bucket `s3://billing-audit/1765436789/`.
ops-lead: summary for postmortem: root cause likely emitter retry+dropped epk causing duplicate writes; mitigation = pause retries + dedupe window + reconciliation. action items: 1) enforce strong req_id on emitter, 2) add unit test for epk-null flow, 3) throttling circuit to avoid burst replays. assign owners tomorrow.
jordan: adding postmortem ticket PM-678.
maya: monitoring window complete — ledger stably within normal bounds for 20m.
eng-billing: recon job completed. adjustments queued for billing pipeline, will not auto-charge until audit signoff. final numbers attached in job output link: https://dash.internal/recon/778
ops-lead: good work team. closing pager in 10m if no regression. please keep any follow-ups in PM-678. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: Pager resolved: incident closed by eng-billing after reconciliation.
